message: Hit a kangaroo: bumper, grille, right headlight

steps: Checked bumper, grille and right headlight
Picked parts that fit the SR5 LED trim
Looked for small parts the repair needs

lines.reason_short: Only one front bumper fits this Hilux.
lines.reason_long: Kangaroo strike on the front end points to the front bumper. It costs over $150, so it needs your confirmation.

lines.reason_short: Front grille fits all Hilux trims.
lines.reason_long: The grille was named as damaged and sits right behind the bumper. It is over $150, so please confirm.

lines.reason_short: SR5 uses the LED right headlight.
lines.reason_long: The SR5 has LED headlights, so the halogen unit does not fit. It is non-returnable and costly, so please confirm.

lines.reason_short: Bash plate often gets bent in a front hit.
lines.reason_long: A kangaroo strike strong enough to damage the bumper may have bent the bash plate. Check it before ordering.

result.reply: I suggested the bumper, grille, right LED headlight and a bash plate for this Hilux; please confirm each one.
